checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same jar and wax preserved on pale kitchen counter
must.why: Jar shape, rim, cream wax and wick match closely; the counter is pale. The wax is slightly more yellow.

must.item: Original wooden shelf and plant absent
must.why: The shelf and plant are gone. A small blurred plant-like pot appears in the background, but it is part of the new kitchen scene.

must.item: Warm highlights consistent with upper-left light
must.why: The window glow is at the upper left and the warm light falls on the left side of the jar.

must.item: Grounded shadow toward lower right, no contradictory original shadow
must.why: A soft diagonal shadow falls to the lower right and the base looks anchored. The shadow is a bit hard-edged and starts at the right base.

must.item: Glass edges show new setting, no shelf or plant fragments
must.why: The glass shows the kitchen background and counter; no remnants of the shelf or plant.
The image is 640x640 and has no text.

faults.what: The wax tint shifted slightly more yellow and the jar is a little wider and cleaner than the original, so 'keep the same' is not exact.
The shadow is a hard-edged diagonal wedge that does not fully match the soft glow and haze. The glass shows only a faint reflection on the counter.
The background is a generic blurred kitchen with a faintly odd, blob-like window.

summary: The candle sits convincingly on a pale sunlit counter with a lower-right shadow and upper-left warm light; the wax is slightly more yellow and the shadow a bit hard-edged.
